inspected_sources.finding: Publish resident GPU work and a selected PCIe share first; compute remaining misses on CPU. Uses existing native/GGUF expert layouts, not EXL3.
PCIe share adapts to a startup H2D bandwidth probe for native packs.
Decayed-frequency residency replacement, capped swaps, asynchronous copies during MTP drafting, residency committed after completion.
Lookup-vs-MTP choice uses observed round cost and accepted tokens with a margin and bounded exploration. This is not a batch-size-only heuristic.
Prefill skips resident experts, streams missing experts through a ring on a copy stream, and fences slot reuse; separate host issuer.

local_source_findings.finding: Decode: GPU planner, async route assertion, fixed 32-program UVA copy, update all 512 expert pointers, then expert compute; calls serialized on one stream. Prefill copies the entire layer into one shared staging bank.
LRU scans recency only on promotable misses, then selects victims sequentially from one CTA. An all-hit scan bypass is already implemented.

comparison_limit: Strata source review only; no Strata binary run or apples-to-apples throughput comparison. Quantization formats, CPU path, context and speculation differ.
